message:
fix(file-picker): keep the requested file name in the iOS save sheet

The export picker shows, and saves under, the staged file's own name. The staged
copy was named <UUID>-<name>, so the sheet proposed the UUID. Each export is now
staged in a directory of its own and keeps the requested name; KmpFile exports
are staged the same way instead of exporting the source under its own name.

fix(io): KmpFile.getPath returns a file system path or null

getPath returned the URL string on iOS (file:///…%20…) and the content:// URI on
Android, so callers that opened it as a path found nothing. It now returns a
decoded file system path, or null when the file has none: content: URIs on
Android, non-file URLs on iOS, and every browser file. getName on iOS is decoded
too.

toUriString() is new and returns the URI for callers that want it, such as the
Android folder picker's initialDirectory. readByteArray on iOS opens
security-scoped URLs, so a KmpFile built from a picker URL by hand stays readable.

BREAKING: code that relied on getPath returning a URI should call toUriString.

fix(file-picker): Android save writes the file; iOS exports a copy

Android: the saver kept the pending source in a composition-local variable. The
launcher, created once, wrote to the first composition's variable, while the
result arrived in a later composition, after the save sheet paused and resumed
the activity, and read a null one. Every save produced an empty file. The source
now lives in a holder all compositions share, which also keeps a KmpFile source
across process death. The created document is typed after the extension instead
of */*, and is deleted, with onResult(null), when nothing could be written.

iOS: the export sheet now saves a copy (asCopy) instead of offering to move the
staged file, and a source that cannot be staged reports null instead of
presenting a sheet for a missing file.

Android host tests run the real launcher on Robolectric, recomposing between
launch and result. Modules with androidHostTest sources get the merged test
manifest that Robolectric needs to start the Compose activity.

fix(file-picker): report swipe dismissals and keep picked file names

iOS: the document picker and the save sheet only listened for
documentPickerWasCancelled, which does not fire when a swipe starts before the
presentation animation ends, so onResult was never called and the saver kept its
staged copy. Both now use one delegate that also handles
presentationControllerDidDismiss behind a guard, so each presentation reports
exactly one outcome.

iOS: picked files were copied to <UUID>.<ext>. Copies are now staged like exports,
tmp/calf-file-picker/<UUID>/<original name>, so KmpFile.url keeps the real name
and two picks of the same name never collide.

Android: the saver crashed when no app handles ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT; it now
reports null.

fix(io): KmpFile.getPath on iOS is the path of the readable copy

The original picked location is security scoped, so a path to it could not be
opened after the picker callback. getPath now returns the path of KmpFile.url,
the app's copy, which keeps the picked file's name. getName and toUriString
still describe the original.

feat(file-picker): open dialogs in a picked folder given as a KmpFile

initialDirectory is a String that means a path on Desktop and a URI on Android,
so code passing a picked folder had to know which. FilePickerSettings and
rememberFilePickerSettings now have overloads that take the folder as a KmpFile
and hand it to each platform in its own form.

iOS used to ignore initialDirectory; the document picker and the save dialog
now open in it through directoryURL. The String overloads are unchanged.

feat(io): KmpFile.fromUriString, getSize and getMimeType

fromUriString reads back what toUriString returns, so an app can store a file or
folder and reopen it; it also accepts an absolute path. getSize and getMimeType
cover the common upload checks: Android asks the content provider, iOS and
Desktop the file system and the extension, the web what the browser reports.

The sample keeps its chosen initial folder as a URI string in rememberSaveable
and shows each picked file's size and type. calf-io gets Robolectric host tests,
which also cover the Android getPath change.

The iOS MIME lookup is not unit tested: the simulator test process has no
Uniform Type database, so even UTTypePDF reports no MIME type there.

feat(file-picker): real save dialog on the web where the browser has one

The web saver only triggered an <a download>, so the browser decided where the
file went and the app never heard back. It now uses the File System Access save
dialog (window.showSaveFilePicker) when the browser has it, Chrome, Edge and
other Chromium browsers: the user picks the location, the file is written
through a writable stream, and onResult receives the saved file, or null on
cancel.

Safari and Firefox have no save dialog API, so they keep the download; so does a
browser that refuses the dialog, for example without a user gesture.

feat(file-picker): onError overloads for the picker and saver launchers

Failures used to be invisible or fatal: picked files that could not be copied
were dropped on iOS, a missing documents app crashed the Android picker, a
Desktop dialog that could not be created made the picker do nothing, and a
failed save looked like a cancellation.

rememberFilePickerLauncher and rememberFileSaverLauncher (and the Desktop
FrameWindowScope picker) now have overloads with
onError: (FilePickerException) -> Unit. Cancelling stays an onResult value.
When only some picked files fail, onError is called once and onResult still
gets the readable ones. A failed save is reported only through onError.

The existing overloads keep their behaviour: the picker ignores failures, and
the saver reports them as null.

feat(io): keep access to picked files across restarts with bookmarks

KmpFile.createBookmark returns a string to store, KmpFile.fromBookmark reopens
it, and releaseBookmark gives the access up.

Android takes and releases a persisted URI permission, and fromBookmark returns
null once it is gone. iOS stores Foundation bookmark data; the reopened file
starts its security-scoped access at once and holds it until releaseBookmark,
following FileKit's finding (#667) that access started per operation on rebuilt
paths fails after a device restart. Desktop stores the path; the web has no
bookmarks.

iOS source() now opens the file inside its security-scoped access. The sample
keeps its initial folder as a bookmark, falling back to the URI.

fix(file-picker): keep the web download's blob URL alive for Safari

The download fallback revoked the object URL right after the click.
Safari reads the blob after the click returns and could fail the
download, so the URL is now revoked after 40 s, as FileSaver.js does.

Docs: Chrome on Android 132+ gets the save dialog, and Safari/Firefox
users can turn on their browser's ask-where-to-save setting.

issue.title: [High][IO-001] iOS byte-array reads can overrun native destination memory and mishandle empty files

repository.name: nativeCmpkit
repository.description: Independent Kotlin Multiplatform native component toolkit, derived from Calf with preserved Apache-2.0 attribution and history.

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-001 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-001
- **Priority:** High
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-io`, `calf-file-picker-coil`
- **Estimated complexity:** S
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt:35-41`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt#L35-L41) — `KmpFile.readByteArray`
- [`calf-file-picker-coil/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/coil/KmpFileFetcher.kt:22-27`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker-coil/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/coil/KmpFileFetcher.kt#L22-L27) — `KmpFileFetcher.fetch`

## Root cause
The ByteArray allocation clamps NSData.length to Int.MAX_VALUE, but memcpy still receives the original, larger length. The zero-length case unconditionally calls addressOf(0).

## Impact and preconditions
For a file larger than Int.MAX_VALUE whose allocations succeed, native writes exceed the Kotlin buffer. Empty data violates the element-address precondition. Coil reaches this path too. This is memory-unsafety in source, not a demonstrated device exploit.

## Supporting evidence
- Baseline lines 37 and 40 use different allocation/copy lengths. No guard precedes addressOf(0).
- Linux cannot execute Foundation or Kotlin/Native iOS behavior. The unsafe arithmetic is source-confirmed.
- The archived PR #551 branch retains this memcpy pattern; its other IO changes do not fix this finding.

## Recommended solution
Return immediately for length zero, reject lengths exceeding the representable ByteArray limit before allocating, copy exactly the validated allocation size, and prefer source() for large content. Make NSData read failure an explicit error.

## Risks and compatibility
Native bounds fixes must preserve byte signedness and all platforms' exception contracts. Large-file tests must not exhaust devices; use a checked-length helper and controlled native fixtures.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Zero-byte valid file
- One-byte and binary round trips
- Length helper at Int.MAX_VALUE and Int.MAX_VALUE+1 without huge allocations
- Missing/unreadable file errors
- ASan/native guarded-buffer integration where supported
- Coil error propagation

## Dependencies
- None identified.

## Historical context
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/551

<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-002 -->

- **Priority:** High
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** M

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt:31-32`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt#L31-L32) — `pendingSource`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt:34-60`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt#L34-L60) — `ActivityResult callback`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt:65-74`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt#L65-L74) — `remembered launch lambdas`

## Root cause
remember<Any?> { null } remembers null, not a mutable holder. Each recomposition creates a new local variable/reference cell. The once-remembered launcher assigns the initial cell while rememberLauncherForActivityResult updates to a callback capturing the latest cell.

## Impact and preconditions
After recomposition while the save sheet is open, source is null and the write branch is skipped; onResult still returns KmpFile(uri). ByteArray and KmpFile exports can silently produce zero-byte documents. Pending sources also lack a process-recreation policy and are not cleared.

## Supporting evidence
- The Kotlin capture structure is directly visible at lines 32,42,65-73.
- Unmerged upstream commit be274cc530ff92e6e3bde9ac0ffbb912d5e3068a independently describes this exact recomposition defect and adds host tests; those tests were not run here.

## Recommended solution
Store a PendingSaveRequest in a remembered state/holder shared by launch and callback. Consume and clear exactly once; define process-death recovery separately for URI and in-memory payloads; fail/clean up rather than returning success when required content is unavailable.

## Risks and compatibility
Do not put large ByteArrays in saved-instance Bundle state. Serialize concurrent launch attempts, and distinguish intentional null/empty content from lost pending state.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Compose/Robolectric launch, recompose, then result for bytes and KmpFile
- Activity recreation with pending URI and ByteArray
- Cancel clears payload
- Repeated/concurrent launch policy
- No-op write cannot report success

## Dependencies
- None identified.

- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt:94-113`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt#L94-L113) — `onLaunch/onLaunchFile/onLaunchData`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt:119-123`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt#L119-L123) — `writeTempFile`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt:137-150`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt#L137-L150) — `presentExportPicker`

## Root cause
The KmpFile overload passes file.url directly, ignoring baseName/extension. The byte/data path prefixes the requested filename with a UUID in the filename itself. The one-argument forExportingURLs initializer uses move-style export instead of explicitly selecting asCopy=true.

## Impact and preconditions
The Save API can offer Move and transfer the source rather than leave it intact. Exported names can unexpectedly contain UUID prefixes or retain the original source name. Saved KmpFiles may also point outside ongoing security-scoped access.

## Supporting evidence
- Baseline passes file.url directly at 109 and constructs UUID-filename at 120.
- Unmerged commits 675d049 and be274cc in PR #551 implement named staging and asCopy=true; their existence corroborates the baseline defect, not its repair on main.
- No iOS device run was available.

## Recommended solution
Stage all exports in a unique private directory under the exact requested basename, preserve source contents, use the explicit copy export initializer, and remove only owned staging after terminal completion. Validate/normalize filename components.

## Risks and compatibility
Staging adds disk IO but not whole-file heap buffering. Handle scope acquisition and failure before presenting a picker. Prevent path separators from escaping or corrupting the staging layout.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Verify source remains after successful save
- Bytes/NSData/KmpFile/NSURL export has exact suggested name
- Cancel and interactive dismissal cleanup
- Unicode and separator-containing names
- Read-only/disk-full staging
- Destination access after callback

<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-006 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-006
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** L
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt:42-60`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt#L42-L60) — `save result IO`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt:80-88,119-123`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt#L80-L88) — `launchWithData/writeTempFile`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/desktopMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.desktop.kt:32-45,49-62`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/desktopMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.desktop.kt#L32-L45) — `save coroutines`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.kt:8-18`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.kt#L8-L18) — `result-only contract`

## Root cause
Android uses nullable stream ?.use chains and unconditionally emits KmpFile(uri) even when opening a stream returned null. iOS ignores NSData.writeToURL Boolean and returns its URL regardless. IO exceptions in remembered coroutine scopes have no common error channel/terminal-result policy.

## Impact and preconditions
Callers may show successful exports for unwritten content, present a picker for nonexistent staging, or remain waiting when failures escape. Partial created documents are not systematically rolled back. A cancellation result cannot communicate a provider/disk failure.

## Supporting evidence
- Android lines 47,52-53 skip failed opens but line 60 still emits a file.
- iOS line 122 ignores the only success result.
- The unmerged PR #551 introduces onError overloads and staging checks; baseline has neither.

## Recommended solution
Check every open/write/copy result, close resources, remove only newly created owned partial files on failure, and add backward-compatible typed onError/result overloads. Keep cancellation distinct and rethrow coroutine cancellation rather than converting it to a generic error.

## Risks and compatibility
Do not delete an existing user-selected destination when cleanup ownership is unknown. Existing callbacks may rely on current null behavior, so document migration semantics.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Resolver returns null input/output stream
- Permission revoked during read/write
- Disk-full and failing close
- iOS writeToURL returns false
- Cancellation during copy
- Exactly one terminal event for success/cancel/error

- IO-004
- IO-005

issue.title: [Medium][IO-007] iOS picker completion is not exactly once and document swipe dismissal is not observed

repository.name: nativeCmpkit
repository.description: Independent Kotlin Multiplatform native component toolkit, derived from Calf with preserved Apache-2.0 attribution and history.

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-007 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-007
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** M
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt:74-134`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt#L74-L134) — `UIDocumentPicker delegate`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt:172-209`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt#L172-L209) — `PHPicker delegate/hasFinished`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt:214-243`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt#L214-L243) — `photo dismiss delegate and guard reset`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt:48-78,137-150`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt#L48-L78) — `save document delegate/presentation`

## Root cause
PHPicker computes processResult with compareAndSet but only gates the empty-result branch; every nonempty didFinishPicking list is processed even when the guard is already set. UIDocumentPicker paths implement documentPickerWasCancelled but do not attach an adaptive presentation delegate for interactive dismissal.

## Impact and preconditions
Repeated photo completion can duplicate copies and callbacks; cancellation followed by late results can deliver contradictory events. Document picker/saver swipe-dismissal may never notify the caller or clean up pending staging.

## Supporting evidence
- Nonempty branch at 184 bypasses processResult whereas else-if at 203 uses it.
- Commit e927149 changed the previous unconditional duplicate guard into this branching structure.
- UIDocumentPicker has no adaptive presentation delegate in baseline; PR #551 adds one. Platform callback sequences remain device-unverified.

## Recommended solution
Use a per-launch terminal-state machine and enforce it for all result branches and late callbacks; support the platform interactive-dismiss callback for document picker and saver as well as photo picker. Keep delegates alive for the session.

## Risks and compatibility
Photo providers may emit cancellation and completion in surprising order; rejecting duplicates must not resurrect the historical lost-result problem. Separate dialog dismissal from asynchronous result-processing completion.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-008 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-008
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `risk` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-io`, `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** L
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt:81-95,109-122,316-322`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt#L81-L95) — `folder results and asCopy=false`
- [`calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt:22-31,35-36,55-57`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt#L22-L31) — `raw NSURL wrappers/read/metadata`
- [`calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFileSource.ios.kt:9-11`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFileSource.ios.kt#L9-L11) — `source`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FilePickerLauncher.android.kt:180-185,207-214,237-242`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FilePickerLauncher.android.kt#L180-L185) — `SAF URI results`

## Root cause
Folder selection returns an external NSURL directly and no operation in these modules balances start/stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource or models bookmarks. Android returns SAF/photo URIs without an opt-in persisted grant/bookmark abstraction. Common KmpFile does not express ownership or access expiry.

## Impact and preconditions
External folder/provider access and restored references can fail outside a callback/session or after process restart, despite metadata strings still existing. Nonfolder iOS picks are copied, reducing but not eliminating lifetime concerns for manually wrapped or exported URLs. Exact behavior depends on provider and OS.

## Supporting evidence
- Baseline iOS folder branch uses KmpFile(nsUrl) and forOpeningContentTypes asCopy=false.
- No startAccessingSecurityScopedResource or takePersistableUriPermission call is present in the audited baseline modules.
- PR #551/c70d35c is unmerged prior work on persisted bookmarks; platform consequences here are explicitly risk-classified.

## Recommended solution
Define explicit ephemeral versus owned versus persisted file handles. Add scoped-access helpers and opt-in bookmark/persistable-permission APIs with release/revocation handling; do not blanket-persist every selection. Document paths that are safe only while access is held.

## Risks and compatibility
Security scopes must be balanced on all exits and must remain active while streaming, not merely while opening. Persisting user permissions is a policy choice and should be explicit. Already sandbox-owned copies must not require successful scope acquisition.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- iCloud/third-party folder access after callback
- Stream open/read/close balances scope
- Android SAF grant release/revoke/restart
- iOS stale bookmark and access denial
- Sandbox-local file path
- Save destination reopened after callback

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/webMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.web.kt:21-44,47-60`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/webMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.web.kt#L21-L44) — `rememberFileSaverLauncher/triggerDownload`

## Root cause
The web implementation ignores onResult and only clicks a Blob-backed download anchor. The common API has no distinct StartedDownload result or capability indicator, while its callback is documented as saved-file or cancellation.

## Impact and preconditions
Cross-platform UI awaiting completion remains pending on every browser save. A downloaded Blob is not a filesystem-confirmed save, so reporting a made-up KmpFile success would be equally misleading.

## Supporting evidence
- onResult appears only in the function signature in the baseline web saver.
- PR #551/ff62e5b adds a real save path on supporting browsers but still explicitly cannot observe download completion on others.

## Recommended solution
Document and expose download-only versus verifiable-save capabilities. Add a real File System Access API save path where available and a distinct started-download event/fallback contract where completion cannot be observed, keeping old overloads compatible.

## Risks and compatibility
Browser support, secure contexts, user activation and iframe restrictions vary. Do not falsely equate anchor.click with persisted data, or return null cancellation merely because a download was initiated.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Chromium File System Access success/cancel/error if added
- Safari/Firefox download fallback state transition
- Caller never waits for an unsupported terminal event
- User activation and insecure-context fallback
- JS/Wasm parity

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-012 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-012
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `risk` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** S
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/webMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.web.kt:51-60`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/webMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.web.kt#L51-L60) — `triggerDownload`

## Root cause
triggerDownload revokes the object URL synchronously immediately after anchor.click and removing the anchor, assuming the browser has already consumed the Blob.

## Impact and preconditions
Browsers that resolve the download after the click returns can see a revoked URL and fail or create no download. This is a source-confirmed lifetime hazard with upstream Safari corroboration, but no Safari/WebKit run was available here.

## Supporting evidence
- Baseline invokes revokeObjectURL at line 60 in the same synchronous function as click at 58.
- Archived unmerged commit 66e345a9b291d4d82aa76b1f5f0d05e99b1bb8e1 describes Safari failures and uses deferred revocation.

## Recommended solution
Retain the URL until a documented safe deferred revocation point or platform-supported completion signal, and clean it up on exceptions. Keep a bounded lifecycle strategy rather than leaking every download URL.

## Risks and compatibility
There is no universal anchor-download completion signal. A delay is a pragmatic fallback, not proof of save completion; large downloads and background tabs must be tested.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Safari macOS and iOS small/large downloads
- Chrome/Firefox unaffected positive paths
- Repeated downloads and URL retention bounds
- Anchor/create/click failure cleanup

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-013 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-013
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-io`, `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** L
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/TempFile.kt:13-25`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/TempFile.kt#L13-L25) — `NSURL.createTempFile`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt:105-124`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt#L105-L124) — `document result staging`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt:185-197,266-285`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FilePickerLauncher.ios.kt#L185-L197) — `photo provider staging`
- [`calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt:15-27`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt#L15-L27) — `KmpFile ownership contract`

## Root cause
Every nonfolder selection creates a new UUID-named file in NSTemporaryDirectory. KmpFile exposes no dispose/release-owned-copy operation and no cleanup registry exists. Document multi-select stages every URL before take(maxItems); cancelled/late photo callbacks can stage files that no caller receives.

## Impact and preconditions
Repeated or very large picks consume unbounded temporary disk until external OS cleanup. Files excluded by maxItems still incur copy IO and survive. The property documentation calls a temp copy persistent even though the OS may purge it.

## Supporting evidence
- TempFile.kt only copies; no complementary delete exists for picker-created copies in these modules. Saver cleanup is a separate list and does not cover picked copies.
- Document list take occurs after mapNotNull and withContext copies at line 122.
- Photo cancellation calls progress.cancel but has no cleanup for copied results abandoned during coroutine delivery.

## Recommended solution
Define owned staging lifetimes and expose explicit release/copy-to-permanent-storage behavior without deleting caller-owned files. Apply limits before staging, remove unreturned copies on cancellation/error, and bound photo provider concurrency. Retain provider temporary content synchronously before the provider callback ends.

## Risks and compatibility
Never delete picked user originals. Automatic early cleanup must not invalidate returned KmpFiles still in use; ownership must be explicit and backwards-compatible. NSItemProvider callback URLs must be copied before callback return.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Repeated pick/release disk accounting
- Select 100 files with maxItems=1 and assert only one staged
- Cancel during provider copy
- Failure halfway through multi-select
- Returned file lifetime and explicit persistence
- OS purge behavior documented

- IO-007
- IO-008

repository.name: nativeCmpkit

issue.body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-014 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-014
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-io`
- **Estimated complexity:** M
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt:18-24,45-57`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.ios.kt#L18-L24) — `getName/getPath/isDirectory`
- [`calf-io/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/io/KmpFile.android.kt:40-51`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/io/KmpFile.android.kt#L40-L51) — `getName/getPath/isDirectory`
- [`calf-io/src/webMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.web.kt:15-17`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/webMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.web.kt#L15-L17) — `getName/getPath`
- [`calf-io/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.kt:26-40`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-io/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/io/KmpFile.kt#L26-L40) — `metadata contract`

## Root cause
iOS extracts a name by splitting originalUrl.absoluteString rather than lastPathComponent, retaining URL escapes. getPath also returns originalUrl.absoluteString rather than the path of its readable temp copy. Android returns URI strings and web returns only names under the same path API.

## Impact and preconditions
Names such as report%20one.pdf are not the expected human/file name; consumers passing getPath to a filesystem API can fail on file:// or content:// strings, inaccessible iOS originals, or ambiguous browser basenames. isDirectory may query a transient original instead of the readable URL.

## Supporting evidence
- iOS names and paths both derive from originalUrl.absoluteString despite the KmpFile docs warning it may be inaccessible.
- Current source() already avoids getPath on Android and uses url.path on iOS; this is the safe content access route.
- PR #551 e2ded9f/b82e19d implements a path-versus-URI distinction; not merged into baseline.

## Recommended solution
Separate URI serialization from optional filesystem paths; define platform guarantees in API docs, use NSURL.lastPathComponent for names and the readable copy for a filesystem path, and encourage source() for content instead of reverse-engineering paths.

## Risks and compatibility
Existing consumers may depend on URI-string getPath behavior. Introduce explicit toUriString/path APIs or a documented migration rather than silently changing all meanings. Preserve original display name when staging.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Space, percent, Unicode and slash-escaped URL names
- Readable iOS temp-copy path after original expires
- Android content:// vs file://
- Two browser files with identical names
- Round-trip URI serialization independent of path
